subject: english
question:
**Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:**

The monk rested near the cloister's **ambulatory**.

options.text: The architect designed the ambulatory around the apse.
The hospital's ambulatory was upgraded with oxygen ports.
The tourist strolled the ambulatory of the cathedral.
The relics were displayed along the gothic ambulatory.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"ambulatory"** has two meanings: • As used in the context of the sentence "The monk rested near the cloister's ambulatory," it refers to a place for walking, especially an aisle or walkway around the apse or choir of a church or cloister. (गिरजाघर के चारों ओर का गलियारा) • **Example:** The tourist admired the architecture while walking through the ambulatory of the historic cathedral. • In Option 2, the word "ambulatory" is used as a homonym, meaning "relating to or adapted for walking" or "able to walk; not bedridden." (चलने योग्य / चलने में सक्षम) • **Example:** The hospital's ambulatory patients are encouraged to exercise daily. • Hence, the sentence in Option 2 contains the homonym of the highlighted word. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1:** The architect designed the ambulatory around the apse. (गिरजाघर के अप्स के चारों ओर गलियारा बनाया।) • This refers to the architectural feature of a church, not the homonym. • **Example:** The ambulatory allowed visitors to walk around the central altar. • **Option 3:** The tourist strolled the ambulatory of the cathedral. (पर्यटक ने गिरजाघर के गलियारे में सैर की।) • This also refers to the same architectural feature as in the highlighted word. • **Example:** The tourist took photographs while strolling through the ambulatory. • **Option 4:** The relics were displayed along the gothic ambulatory. (धार्मिक अवशेषों को गॉथिक गलियारे में प्रदर्शित किया गया।) • This again refers to the architectural feature and not the homonym. • **Example:** The gothic ambulatory was adorned with intricate carvings. 45:Tf8a, The correct answer is **Option 3**.
